strategy.purpose: To help busy adults reclaim their energy and confidence through accessible, science-backed wellness solutions.
strategy.mission: We curate and provide effective supplements and weight-loss medicines to help people transform their health affordably.
strategy.vision: A world where proven, effective wellness products are accessible to everyone seeking sustainable health transformation.
values: Efficacy — results matter more than marketing
Accessibility — affordable, fast, and available to all
Empowerment — we help people take control of their health
Trust — reliable products people can depend on

persona.demographics: Age 25–70, US and Canada, balanced gender, health/fitness conscious

psychographics.motivation: Regain energy, lose weight sustainably, feel confident again
psychographics.primary_fear: Wasting money on products that don't work or making false promises
psychographics.buying_trigger: Social proof (testimonials, before/afters), scientific evidence, affordable price point
psychographics.job_to_be_done: Transform my body and energy without the guesswork or the hype

strategy.value_proposition: Skip the supplement trial-and-error hunt. Our science-backed, curated selection gets you real energy and weight-loss results affordably—backed by research, not marketing.
strategy.differentiation: In a crowded affiliate space, we win on curation (efficacy-first selection), transparency (no miracle claims), and affordability ($100–$300 price point). We are the thinking person's weight-loss marketplace.
strategy.positioning_statement: For busy adults aged 25–70 seeking sustained energy and weight loss, Health & Care is the curated marketplace of science-backed supplements that delivers transformative results without the hype, because our selection is driven by efficacy research, not profit maximization.
messaging_pillars: Science-Backed Selection — We choose supplements backed by clinical research, not marketing noise
Real Transformation — Proven results via testimonials and before/afters from real customers
Affordable Access — Effective health solutions at $100–$300, not $500+ markup
Transparent Promises — No miracle claims, no hype—just honest, science-backed efficacy
Reclaim Your Energy — Lose the weight, reclaim your life, your confidence, your power
strategy.promise: We guarantee measurable energy and weight-loss results, or your money back within 30 days.

verbal.name: Health & Care

name_candidates.name: Health & Care
name_candidates.trademark_note: no USPTO_ODP_API_KEY — verify manually at https://tmsearch.uspto.gov (set USPTO_ODP_API_KEY to automate)

traits: Educational — explain the science, no hype
Bold — confident in results, unafraid of bold claims backed by data
Urgent — time is of the essence; energy and weight are quality-of-life issues
Transparent — honest about what works, what doesn't, why
do: Use before/afters and testimonials as proof
dont: Never use fake urgency ('only 3 spots left')
Never claim to treat or diagnose medical conditions
Never disparage competitors or other brands
Never use vague wellness language ('life-changing' without proof)
Never oversell — stick to what the products deliver

verbal.elevator_pitch: Health & Care is the curated marketplace for weight-loss and energy supplements. We choose products backed by clinical research, not marketing hype. Real results, affordable prices, proven by thousands of happy customers.
verbal.boilerplate: Health & Care is a science-backed supplement marketplace dedicated to helping busy adults achieve sustainable weight loss and reclaim their energy. Our curated selection features only clinically proven products at $100–$300, with a 30-day money-back guarantee. Available in the US and Canada.

typography.heading: Poppins Bold (48-36px for display/H1, 24px for H2, 600-700 weight)
typography.body: Inter Regular (16-18px body, 14px small, 1.5-1.6 line height)

visual.imagery_style: Real people, authentic before/afters, diverse (25-70 age range). Warm lighting, no stock clichés. Color grading: warm saturation on skin tones, complements blue+teal palette. Layout: clean, spacious, medical authority without coldness.
visual.iconography: Minimal stroke-based icons (Feather/Lucide style, modified). Rounded corners, 2px consistent stroke. Energy bolt (green #34C759), leaf (teal #20B2AA), checkmark & shield (blue #0066CC).

templates: quote: Pull-quote in brand voice (Poppins Bold, 36-48px on gradient blue-to-teal background)
tip: Educational carousel cover (1080×1350) with header, stat, and teal CTA
promo: Product image + price + Shop Now CTA button in primary blue
testimonial: Before/after image + quote, blue frame with teal accent
story-cta: Vertical story (1080×1920) with safe margins (top 250px, bottom 310px)
